page.layout: Two parallel columns separated by a vertical rule, left column and right column. No marginal notes. Below the columns, a small mark at the foot left (not transcribed). Header at top of each column, partly damaged.

main_text.l: Rad. הָלַל.
לִנְהֹל, Infin. Kal, לְנַחֵל ad possidendum, Inf.
Piel, praef. Rad. הלל
נַחֲלָה, vel נְחָלָה egritudine affecta; נְחָלָה affecte, Part. Niph. f. & pl. f. Rad. חלה
נַחְלָה, & נְחָלָה vallis, ad vallem, No. f. m. נחל cum ה parag. vel ה loc.
R. נָחַל possedit.
נָחֲלוּ possederunt, praet. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָחַל.
נָחֲלוּ infirmi fuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. a f. m. נְחָלָה, Rad. חָלָה.
נַחְלוּ possidendum tradiderunt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. R. נָחַל.
נְחַלּוּ profanati fuerunt, Ezech. 7. 24. praet. Niph. pl. Rad. חָלַל.
נַחֲלוֹת possessiones, pl. f. No. נַחֲלָה, R. נָחַל possedit.
נְחָלִים torrentes, & נְחָלִים
duo, נַחֲלוֹ ejus, pl. m. vel dual. aff. No. f. m. נַחַל, Rad. נָחַל
נָחְלִיךְ [?]renovabimus [?], fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. [?]
נַחְלִיתִי egritudine affectus fui, praet. Niph. 1. f. R. חָלָה.
נְחַלְמָה somnia vimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. חָלַם.
נֶחְלָץ liberatur, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. R. חָלַץ.
נֶחָלְצוּ liberabimur, fut. Niph. 1. pl. R. חָלַץ.
נַחֲלְתִּי possidere fecisti, praet. Piel, 2. f. f. R. נָחַל.
נְחֻלָּה profanata fuisti, Ezech. 22. 16. pro נְחָלוּ, praet. Niph. 2. f. f. Rad. חָלַל.
נַחְלִי possedi, praet. Kal, 1. f. R. נָחַל.
נַחֲלָתָן possessio earum, נַחֲלָתָם nostra, נַחֲלַתְכֶם vestra, נַחֲלוֹתֵיהֶם possessiones, sing. fem. aff. & pl.

page.notes: Page is heavily blotted and speckled; many Hebrew vowel points and consonants are uncertain and were not read letter by letter. Right column line 2 (Latin word "renovabimus") and the Hiphil root after it are doubtful. Running head and page number at the top are partly illegible; the printed "3" is read from the right header. The small mark at the bottom left is not transcribed. Hebrew lines are reproduced as best read; the Latin abbreviations were kept as printed.
